# Graft API overview

| Import                         | Export                                     | Purpose                                                                       |
| ------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `@fungi.computer/graft`        | `createShiitakeAcpAgent`                   | Project an authorized Shiitake Session through ACP.                           |
| `@fungi.computer/graft`        | `createAuthorizedShiitakeSessionDirectory` | Adapt a host-authorized client lease factory to Session creation and loading. |
| `@fungi.computer/graft`        | `AuthorizedShiitakeSessionDirectory`       | Let the host authorize Session creation and loading.                          |
| `@fungi.computer/graft`        | `agentAcpMethods`                          | Expose the maintained ACP agent methods.                                      |
| `@fungi.computer/graft/server` | `createShiitakeAcpServer`                  | Serve the same adapter through Streamable HTTP.                               |

The host supplies authorization. Shiitake owns Session state and the durable
transcript. Close connections to release their client leases and observations;
closing a lease does not delete the Session. The generated module pages below
include the option, lease and server types.
